import numpy as np

base = np.load('/work/fwd/r1/run.npz')
abl = np.load('/work/fwd/r4/run.npz')

print("Effect of L0H0_ATTN=zero on downstream MLPs:")
for comp in ['L0_MLP', 'L1_MLP', 'L2_MLP', 'L3_MLP']:
    b = base[comp]
    a = abl[comp]
    max_diff = np.max(np.abs(b - a))
    mean_diff = np.mean(np.abs(b - a))
    print(f"  {comp}: max|diff|={max_diff:.4f}, mean|diff|={mean_diff:.4f}")
